% Pattern: number/option-off. A local class resets theorem in a block that
% only an option of the class runs, and the document does not give the
% option, so theorem is not reset. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=none
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 2 status=none
% want theorem-2 statement/theorem 3 status=none
\documentclass{journal}
\begin{document}
\section{Introduction}
\begin{theorem} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\section{Products}
\subsection{Finite products}
\begin{lemma} Every finite product of compact spaces is compact. \end{lemma}
\subsection{Infinite products}
\begin{theorem} Every product of compact spaces is compact. \end{theorem}
\end{document}
